shared_elements: schematic anthropomorphic/rayed figures or limb-like radiating lines
a horizontal band dividing or belting the surface
justification: Both surfaces carry highly schematic, non-naturalistic marks — radiating stick-like limbs and arcs in A, and concentric rings, arcs and a belt-like horizontal band in B — but these are the most generic kinds of correspondences imaginable. A shows a multi-figure scene of small repeated figures spread across stacked horizontal registers, while B is a single large three-dimensional human bust whose surface motifs (rings, curved bands, a girdle) are ornaments attached to a body rather than a populated scene; there is no shared specific motif or relationship.
